supporter_members_patreon_fields_check.name: supporter_members_patreon_fields_check
supporter_members_patreon_fields_check.value: "supporter_members"."provider" <> 'patreon' or ("supporter_members"."campaign_id" is not null and "supporter_members"."patreon_member_id" is not null)

supporter_members_paypal_fields_check.name: supporter_members_paypal_fields_check
supporter_members_paypal_fields_check.value: "supporter_members"."provider" <> 'paypal' or ("supporter_members"."campaign_id" is null and "supporter_members"."patreon_member_id" is null)

supporter_members_discord_source_check.name: supporter_members_discord_source_check
supporter_members_discord_source_check.value: "supporter_members"."discord_source" is null or ("supporter_members"."discord_id" is not null and ("supporter_members"."discord_source" = 'staff' or ("supporter_members"."discord_source" = 'patreon' and "supporter_members"."provider" = 'patreon')))

supporter_members_steam_source_check.name: supporter_members_steam_source_check
supporter_members_steam_source_check.value: "supporter_members"."steam_source" is null or ("supporter_members"."steam_id" is not null and ("supporter_members"."steam_source" = 'staff' or ("supporter_members"."steam_source" = 'application' and "supporter_members"."provider" = 'patreon')))

supporter_members_steam_application_chec.name: supporter_members_steam_application_check
supporter_members_steam_application_chec.value: ("supporter_members"."steam_application_id" is null and "supporter_members"."steam_source" is distinct from 'application') or ("supporter_members"."steam_application_id" is not null and "supporter_members"."steam_source" = 'application')

supporter_payments_paypal_fields_check.name: supporter_payments_paypal_fields_check
supporter_payments_paypal_fields_check.value: "supporter_payments"."source" <> 'paypal' or ("supporter_payments"."campaign_id" is null and "supporter_payments"."amount_cents" is not null and "supporter_payments"."currency" is not null and "supporter_payments"."verification_state" = 'verified')
